label: nyiso 20 daily-coopt-floors
definition: KEEPER. The daily-Transco-gas keeper lineage (nyiso-16/17) combined for the first time with the three validated fix-#3 structural mechanisms: in-LP LOCATIONAL reserve co-optimization (--energy-reserve-coopt, 7 nested NYCA/East/SENY/NYC reserve families), the Long Island in-city self-supply floor (--nyiso-local-selfsupply, NYISO LMIC/local-reliability rule), and firm HQ/Ontario must-flow imports (--nyiso-firm-imports). Full config: --commitment --gas-monthly-actuals --gas-hub-basis-overlay --gas-hub-basis-daily --priced-interchange --energy-reserve-coopt --nyiso-local-selfsupply --nyiso-firm-imports, all 2023+2024+2025. ROOT-CAUSE of the gating winter/January downstate over-pricing: it is the gas-level artifact (the EIA-923 January receipt cost is winter-storm-inflated), NOT an import-topology bug. The measured daily Transco Z6 NY spot de-smears the within-month cold spike, collapsing the January downstate over-price from ~$98 -> $49 (load-weighted Jan residual +44 -> +5.8) and the over-generating NYC fleet from 40 -> 33.6 TWh (toward EIA-923 29). Canonical gate (verdict price_mean): 2023 +19.9% (keeper nyiso-17 +24.0%), 2024 +2.1% (keeper +7.2%, PASS), 2025 +1.2% (keeper +5.4%, PASS) -- BEATS the keeper on price every year; price_shape 2023 0.212 (keeper 0.251), 2024 0.250 (keeper 0.262). 2023 co2 now PASSES (keeper FAIL +7.7%); 2023 sysvol-gas +3.0% (keeper +5.1%); the keeper's ST_GAS +5.05 TWh fuelmix overshoot is gone. Volume bands held within ~1pp of the documented EIA-930/923 import basis floor (2024/25 gas -11/-9%). REMAINING (bounded, documented): the ~+5-7 $/MWh roughly-uniform downstate body over-price is the import/congestion residual bounded by the gas band (PJM $34 > downstate $29-38, so the deep import tranches cannot clear without breaking the EIA-923 gas band) plus the data-blocked flat-annual Iroquois-Transco summer over-level (fix #1(b), needs a paywalled monthly Iroquois Z2 series -- a winter-concentrated/multiplicative reconstruction is mean-preserving on annual gas and only trades summer for winter, so it is not a clean fix). Dec-2024 -27 and the short 2025 summer tail are the coopt-winter-eligibility follow-on (handoff #2). No fitted adders/haircuts; every input measured and forward-reproducible.
